scope: Observed-data source planning for several related scientific questions. These are metadata-reviewed candidates; no new biological payload was downloaded, no task was implemented, and no candidate is cleared for training export by this file.

policy.reuse_unit: Share acquisition, identity reconciliation and native environment preparation across compatible questions. Each task still answers one coherent question and retains its own complete private oracle/verifier contract.
policy.realism: Keep the biological replicate count and observation structure needed by the estimand. Bound cells, loci or genomic regions by declared outcome-independent eligibility, not by selecting observations that force a desired answer.
policy.single_split: The corpus has one train split. Held-out subjects, cells or observations inside a predictive task are part of its scientific evaluation protocol, with evaluation labels private to the verifier.
policy.no_automatic_coverage: A source's availability or a question's eligibility does not establish benchmark endpoint equivalence. Preserve benchmark biological-context and method departures explicitly.
policy.lineage_screen: Check accessions, DOI, project IDs, originating cohorts and known mirrors against all permitted ID-source metadata before authoring. Absence of an identifier match is only a preliminary screen. Uninspected/gated source fixtures prevent a universal nonoverlap claim. Do not deanonymize OOD inputs.
policy.metadata_only: Primary landing pages and existing versioned manifests were inspected. Raw images, sequence reads, matrices and expected benchmark outputs were not fetched for this planning review.

collections.metadata_evidence: HCA describes ten healthy adult donors, untreated and two observed immune-activation conditions, paired RNA/protein measurements, 39 antibody targets and an estimated 250,000 cells. The portal lists three Rds, one CSV, one XLSX and 60 compressed FASTQ files; payload schemas were not inspected. HCA explicitly lists CC BY 4.0 for downloaded/exported data.
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Processed observed RNA counts and measured ADT counts with source cell, donor, condition and demultiplexing identities. Preserve source R objects for provenance; any H5AD/MuData conversion must document all layers and metadata without altering observations.
collections.proposed_sampling: Retain all ten biological donors if sample-level condition coverage is confirmed. A declared donor/condition-stratified cell subset can bound computation; use no expression-effect or prediction-performance criterion to select cells.
scientific_limits: Healthy immune stimulation does not establish disease, tissue-residence, age or genotype effects.
Condition response is observed; it does not provide labels for an unseen genetic perturbation and does not cover a CRISPR generalization endpoint.
Cross-donor protein imputation requires private held-out measured ADT values, not an imputed reference used as truth.

Source cell labels derived from RNA do not provide an independent gold standard for all annotation claims. Freeze label evidence and report circularity; use protein evidence only when independent of the measured target.

collections.metadata_evidence: GEO describes early and late septic groups and healthy controls measured with CITE-seq. The public release enumerates 34 GEX/ADT libraries and a 516.9 MB archive of MTX/TXT files. The study description and deposited library counts must be reconciled before assigning biological sample counts. A dataset-specific redistribution license was not established from the reviewed metadata.
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Observed matched GEX/ADT matrices plus explicit subject and collection-time metadata; use the actual released subjects and sample identifiers.
collections.proposed_sampling: Preserve observed subject groups and all qualifying biological units. Do not interpret different early and late subjects as repeated measurements.
scientific_limits: The cohort mixes myeloid enrichment and Ficoll enrichment. Apparent cell proportions may reflect sampling protocol and cannot automatically be interpreted as in vivo abundance.
Sepsis state and recovery labels are observational; no causal treatment effect follows from this input alone.
The stated cohort size is larger than the enumerated release subset. A source summary cannot replace an actual sample manifest.

collections.metadata_evidence: GEO enumerates 83 libraries spanning GEX, TCR and BCR, with preterm/term cord blood, infant ages and adult samples. Its 1.4 GB processed archive contains CSV/MTX/TSV. The inspected BCR sample provides filtered contig annotations. Repeated sample numbers are not assumed to be globally unique people. Dataset-specific redistribution rights remain unconfirmed.
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Observed receptor contigs, RNA counts and a release-derived sample/donor/age map. Native sequence reassignment requires observed contig sequences and reference segment records, not only precomputed V/J labels.
collections.proposed_sampling: Retain complete selected donor/visit/repertoire records, chain ambiguity and no-receptor cells. Bound to a declared cohort or visit range without filtering on expansion or response.
scientific_limits: This source can support repertoire and developmental-state questions, but it does not supply tumor exhaustion, cancer treatment response or a recorded CD8 sorting gate.
Age groups cannot be declared longitudinal without an explicit donor-visit map.
Starting from observed contigs exercises annotation and downstream repertoire analysis; it does not cover assembly from raw reads.
BCR gene usage and TCR state association remain separate scientific questions even when they share a study.

collections.metadata_evidence: The Dryad README describes one 100-micrometer cortical sample with 242 measured genes and one 200-micrometer hypothalamic sample with 156 genes, each from one P56 male animal. It specifies cell-by-gene tables, segmented-cell coordinates and transcript coordinates in micrometers. The processed ZIP is 3.75 GB; raw imaging is about 3 TB and is not deposited there. Exact version/file checksums and dataset-license metadata still need capture.
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Observed cell-by-gene matrix and segmented-cell x/y/z coordinates from one declared volume, with codebook, field identities and coordinate units. Preserve the measured targeted gene panel.
collections.proposed_sampling: Use a complete declared volume or geometrically bounded region, retaining edge/field indicators. Do not fabricate z coordinates, unmeasured genes or independent animals by dividing one volume.
scientific_limits: Within-volume spatial counting and conditional label-randomization are feasible planning targets. The source does not establish replicated between-condition or between-animal inference.
Cortex and hypothalamus with different panels cannot be treated as interchangeable biological replicates.
Processed-coordinate tasks do not exercise segmentation from raw imaging, and the deposited gene panel cannot establish genome-wide spatial coverage.

collections.proposed_input_boundary: Reuse the existing checksum-pinned observed gene counts and sample metadata for compatible count/statistical questions. Preserve the original biological units, population and condition design.
scientific_limits: Existing native/oracle/Harbor evidence covers the authored RNA task; it does not validate new pathway, semantic-reduction or PyDESeq2 endpoints.
The existing count package does not cover raw FASTQ alignment or donor-paired single-cell analysis.
Re-screen lineage against the expanded benchmark inventory before export; prior screening covered a narrower source set.

accessions: See workflow_designs/multilocus_source.json for accession and revision identity
collections.proposed_input_boundary: Use the previously inspected matched observed ortholog alignments and trees, preserving original loci, taxon identities and clade membership.
scientific_limits: Exact mirror/deposit identity remains unresolved. Local metric checks do not make the complete scientific task validated.
Precomputed ortholog alignments/trees do not exercise discovery, raw sequence alignment or de novo inference.
Preserve the diagnosed native rooting behavior and its explicit reference convention; do not silently change metric semantics.

preliminary_lineage_screen.scope: Versioned benchmark inventories and cached permitted JSON/JSONL/Markdown source metadata. Biological fixtures, expected answers and OOD inputs were not inspected.
preliminary_lineage_screen.finding: No explicit accession/project/DOI match found in the inspected metadata. A numerical substring hit on 90029 was a Git object hash and is not lineage evidence.
preliminary_lineage_screen.remaining: Resolve originating study accessions and exact files against all accessible source descriptions. Uninspected/gated inputs leave residual lineage uncertainty.
